hypothesis_description: S4 v2 4-sleeve (1715 H1 50 + TSMOM_8 25 + KR_10y 20 + Cash 5) static -> regime/risk-conditional dynamic 동적비중조절. 현재 책은 도훈 mandate user-fixed (walk-forward dynamic convergence finding으로 사후 입증). 본 research는 paradigm-free dynamic rule 발견: (i) regime detection 방법론 (HMM / BOCPD / DCC-GARCH / Markov-RS / RMT / M4 변형) + (ii) PIT risk metric (current vol / current cor / CVaR / CDaR / Maximum DD / tail risk) + (iii) dynamic weight rule (Black-Litterman dynamic posterior / HRP / CVaR LP / DRO Wasserstein / Conditional Risk Parity / PPO RL / TSMOM vol scaling / Regime-Switching MVO). objective: walk-forward backtest 256m+OOS SR/CAGR/MDD가 user-fixed static (1.665/26.4%/-16.6%) 대비 strict improve. constraint: hard 20 names + long-only + Σw=1 + bounds [0, 0.20] (sleeve 내) / 4-sleeve aggregate constraints 동일 / transaction cost 15bps + turnover penalty / regime switch lag t-1 / PIT C1~C15. wt_type=sizing_only (alpha source fixed, weight rule only).
